case.title: Scheduled job disk exhaustion
case.description: Host monitoring raised a disk exhaustion alert traced to scheduled jobs in the workspace. An unneeded debugging job is generating unrotated log dumps every minute.

prior_turns.text: Disk exhaustion alerts fired from unrotated dump logs. Review the case notes and identify which scheduled cron job is causing it.
I will review the case notes and inspect the scheduled jobs in the workspace cron table.

memory: The app-report job runs daily at 03:00 and must keep running.
The app-dump job was a temporary debugging task writing unrotated logs and should be stopped.

workspace.content:
#!/bin/sh
# Fails while an uncommented every-minute app-dump entry is scheduled.
if grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*\*[[:space:]]+\*[[:space:]]+\*[[:space:]]+\*[[:space:]]+\*[[:space:]].*app-dump' cron/app.cron 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "app-dump still scheduled every minute"
  exit 1
fi
echo "no every-minute app-dump job"
exit 0

user_message: A disk exhaustion alert was raised for unrotated dump logs. Review the prior case notes, identify the offending job in the workspace cron table, and stop it from recurring while keeping the critical app-report job scheduled.

objective.goal: Stop the job filling disk with dump logs while keeping the daily app-report job scheduled.
